entry.name: launchers
entry.label: Pinned apps, in order (launcher URLs, like the stock task manager's)

entry.name: showLabels
entry.label: Show window titles next to the icons (the Classic layout)

entry.name: iconEpoch
entry.label: Bumped by deckos accent when the icons are recoloured, so the tiles reload them

entry.name: colorMode
entry.label: accent (the desktop's), vibe (the Vibe's two colours) or custom (yours: deckos taskbar colors)

entry.name: motion
entry.label: Gentle motion: the active app's pill breathes, icons lift on hover, a soft glow behind the tiles

entry.name: lockedPins
entry.label: Kid mode: the pinned apps can't be changed (no pinning, unpinning or dropping apps on)

entry.name: onlyThisScreen
entry.label: Only show windows on the screen this taskbar is on (off: one taskbar shows every screen's windows)
